deviations.edit: Human QA found real .kml uploads were rejected by FilePond's client-side acceptedFileTypes (a .kml reports an empty/unknown browser MIME so it matched none of the listed types). Removed acceptedFileTypes; .kml is enforced server-side by the existing extensions:kml rule (reliable) + the graceful parser. AC-2.

Human QA with the real 84KB CPZones.kml: the upload failed CORS because Livewire's temporary_file_upload.disk was null -> default disk = s3 (FILESYSTEM_DISK=s3), so Livewire did a browser-direct-to-S3 temp upload requiring bucket CORS. Fix (config/livewire.php temp disk -> local) was applied + RN4-reviewed 100/100, then REVERTED post-review at Dalton's request: the global Livewire upload-staging config is out of scope for this feature PR. NET RESULT in the PR: config/livewire.php unchanged from main. Upload staging (S3-CORS / temp disk) deferred to env/infra or a separate change; AC-2 real-upload-in-prod is NOT wired by this PR.
